name: @zgo/git-dir
description: Specify the parent folder and execute the git command cyclically for subfolder

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && go build -o dist/git-dir main.go
scripts.build-all: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o dist/git-dir-linux main.go && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o dist/git-dir.exe main.go && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -o dist/git-dir-darwin main.go

keywords: execute git command for all directories of the parent directory
author: zigo
